submitted.rationale: EQE climbs steeply as the film gets more Fe-rich: 0.017% at Sb 0.60, 0.016% at 0.51, 0.106% at 0.31, 0.97% at 0.21 and 1.22% at 0.186 (index 2, the highest measured). XRD at Sb 0.21 and 0.26 shows a mix of a hematite-like peak (Q about 2.34) and rutile FeSbO4-like peaks (Q about 1.92 and 2.47). At Sb 0.15, the XRD pattern is weaker and has no clear hematite (104) peak, so the optimum is probably near Sb 0.17–0.19. I had no EQE budget left to measure indices 0 and 1.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.016%. Near-stoichiometric FeSbO4 is a poor performer here.
Both EQE measurements there were about 70x below the Fe-rich side.
